canonical_project: Chief Telecom Central Taiwan Science Park AI Data Center
notes: Chief Telecom announced in March 2025 it will spend NT$3 billion (about US$96 million) to build its fourth AI data center at the Central Taiwan Science Park (Taichung), expected to begin operations in 2028 (Taiwan News/CNA); twreporter earlier reported a 20 MW Chief Telecom facility planned for the same park, and Chief Telecom confirmed the NT$3bn fourth AI data center plan.
